business.order_lead_time: Order before 6pm for next-day pickup or delivery; custom design cakes need 3 days; party packs need 2 days
business.pickup: Self pickup at the shop during opening hours
business.delivery: Delivery within 10 km of Taman Connaught, RM8 flat fee; free for orders above RM150; delivery slots 10am to 6pm
business.payment: DuitNow QR or bank transfer; full payment before delivery for retail customers; cafes and offices on account pay monthly within 30 days
business.wholesale: Cafes, offices and restaurants get wholesale prices with a minimum of RM100 per delivery
business.allergen_note: Allergens (alahan): our kitchen also handles peanuts and tree nuts (kacang, 花生, 坚果), so all products may contain traces of nuts

faq.q: Can I add a name or message on the cake?
faq.a: Yes, a short message of up to 30 characters is free on any cake.
Yes, 5 small candles are included free with every cake. A number candle is RM3.

faq.q: How long can the cake be kept?
faq.a: Keep cakes refrigerated and finish within 3 days. Bread and kuih are best eaten on the same day.

faq.q: Can I change or cancel my order?
faq.a: Changes and cancellations are free until 6pm the day before. Custom cakes cannot be cancelled once decorating has started, which is 2 days before pickup.

faq.q: Can I order for same-day delivery?
faq.a: Same-day orders are not guaranteed. Message us before 10am and we will check what is available.

faq.q: Do you accept cash on delivery?
faq.a: No, payment is by DuitNow QR or bank transfer before delivery.
